scenario.zh: 提出科研问题,系统起草分析、选择数据源、运行并解释结果
scenario.en: Pose research question, system drafts analysis, selects sources, runs and interprets results

instruction.zh: 选择一个科研问题示例

output.zh: 系统起草分析计划并选择数据源
output.en: System drafts plan and selects sources

input.zh: TP53与哪些蛋白质在细胞凋亡通路中存在直接相互作用?
input.en: Which proteins directly interact with TP53 in apoptosis pathways?

output.zh: 1)查询STRING数据库获取TP53互作网络 2)筛选凋亡通路相关蛋白 3)验证直接结合证据 4)汇总文献支持
output.en: 1) Query STRING database for TP53 network 2) Filter apoptosis-related proteins 3) Verify direct binding evidence 4) Summarize literature support

output.zh: 系统规划统计方法和数据处理
output.en: System plans stats and data handling

input.zh: 比较肺癌样本与正常组织中EGFR通路基因的表达差异
input.en: Compare EGFR pathway gene expression in lung cancer vs normal tissue

output.zh: 1)提取TCGA肺癌RNA-seq数据 2)标准化表达矩阵 3)差异表达分析(DESeq2) 4)EGFR通路富集检验
output.en: 1) Extract TCGA lung cancer RNA-seq 2) Normalize expression matrix 3) Differential expression (DESeq2) 4) EGFR pathway enrichment test

instruction.zh: 查看系统运行后的结果解释

output.zh: 验证模型已审计数据流程

input.zh: 找到12个直接互作蛋白,包含MDM2、BAX、BCL2等已知调控因子
input.en: Found 12 direct interactors including MDM2, BAX, BCL2 and other known regulators

output.zh: 结果与已知凋亡调控一致;MDM2和BAX为高置信度互作;建议验证PUMA结合位点
output.en: Results align with known apoptosis regulation; MDM2 and BAX high-confidence; suggest validating PUMA binding site

detail.zh: 泛素连接酶,负调控TP53稳定性,置信度0.998
detail.en: Ubiquitin ligase, negatively regulates TP53 stability, confidence 0.998

detail.zh: 促凋亡蛋白,TP53直接转录激活,置信度0.995
detail.en: Pro-apoptotic protein, directly activated by TP53, confidence 0.995

detail.zh: 文献支持结合,但结构数据缺失,需实验验证
detail.en: Literature supports binding but structural data missing, needs experimental validation

takeaway.zh: 演示了问题到分析计划、数据源选择和结果解释的流程;验证模型和错误修复能力需在实际科研数据中测试;访问供应商网站连接800+数据源
takeaway.en: Illustrated question-to-plan, source selection and result interpretation flow; verification model and error-fixing require testing with real research data; visit vendor site to connect 800+ sources
